name: Morning Lust
source: You play as a young, muscle-bound, horse-hung boy who wakes up with overbloated balls. You need to unload pronto and multiple times to relieve the aching pain. Fortunately, your busty mom, sis and aunt are nearby to help you, if you play your cards right.
